event_name: Alfa Romeo Sauber F1 Team Document 46 Date 27 May 2018 Time 18:44 2018 MONACO GRAND PRIX 23 - 27 May 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 44 & 45 ) and heard from the drivers and team representatives have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 16 collided with Car 28 in turn 10.
offence: Involved in an alleged incident as defined by Art 38.1 as defined by the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and heard from the driver of car 16, Charles Leclerc, the driver of car 28, Brendon Hartley and team representatives and noted that the collision was caused by the failure of the left brake disc of Car 16 and not through the fault of either driver. Nish Shetty Jose Abed Danny Sullivan Eric Barrabino
title: 2018 Monaco Grand Prix Decision Car 16 Turn 10 Incident46
